verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents customizing the chart of accounts, account types, or sub-accounts. It only states that Wave uses double-entry accounting and offers reports. The homepage line "Tag it, track it" is vague marketing with no stated link to ledger accounts or class/tag dimensions, so it is not credited.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can customize the chart of accounts with account types, sub-accounts, and class or tag dimensions
